newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yaohan Japan to get financial help from banks. [CORRECTED 08:53 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Yaohan Japan to get financial help from banks. [CORRECTED 08:53 GMT]

text.p: Yaohan Japan Corp president Mitsumasa Wada said on Monday that the company would receive financial assistance from Tokai Bank Ltd, Sumitomo Trust and Banking Co Ltd (Corrects from Sumitomo Bank Ltd) and the Long-Term Credit Bank of Japan Ltd.
Wada told a news conference the company would use the banks' help for its daily operations and might seek further assistance in order to redeem bonds.
"The banks have agreed to continue extending financial support for a while," Wada said.
Wada also said that sales of part of Yaohan's securities holdings, as announced in its restructuring plan earlier on Monday, would bring it an income of 8.26 billion yen.
Sales of part of its real-estate assets would also raise 5.4 billion yen, he said.
Meanwhile, stores and offices which are also expected to be sold as part of the restructuring plan had a total book value of 55 billion yen, Wada said.

Referring to 9.6 billion yen worth of corporate bonds that the company will have to redeem in May, Wada said: "We may consult with the banks on further financial help, although we will first try to redeem them on our own."
